title: Senior Consultant-QA
jobDescription: At CDW, we make it happen, together. Trust, connection, and commitment are at the heart of how we work together to deliver for our customers. It’s why we’re coworkers, not just employees. Coworkers who genuinely believe in supporting our customers and one another. We collectively forge our path forward with a level of commitment that speaks to who we are and where we’re headed. We’re proud to share our story and Make Amazing Happen at CDW. Role Summary We are seeking a Consultant / Senior Consultant – QA with strong experience in both Manual and Automation Testing. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience across multiple business domains and enterprise platforms, with exposure to two or more platforms such as eCommerce, AEM, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise applications. Candidates should possess strong UI , API and Database Testing skills, along with automation expertise and exposure to modern Quality Engineering practices. Required Skills & Experience Testing Expertise Strong Manual Testing experience in: Functional Testing Integration Testing Regression Testing End-to-End Testing UI Testing o API Testing Database Testing Domain & Platform Experience Experience across multiple business domains. Hands-on experience in at least two of the following: eCommerce Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Salesforce ServiceNow Other enterprise applications Automation Skills (Mandatory) Hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress. Experience in automation script development, execution, and maintenance. Technical Skills Database Testing using SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or equivalent. API Testing using Postman or similar tools. Good-to-have programming knowledge in: JavaScript TypeScript Java Tools & Methodologies Jira, Xray, Azure DevOps Agile / Scrum methodologies Good to Have Non-Functional Testing (Performance, Accessibility, Security) CI/CD pipeline exposure AI-assisted testing and Generative AI knowledge Experience with AI-driven test case generation and Quality Engineering practices. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and platforms Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work. Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.
